hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Three-phase token launchpad hook: a 50-block guard phase with exponentially decaying fees (90%→3%), a flat 1% curve phase until a cumulative quote graduation threshold is met, then a permanent 1% graduated phase. The hook captures 100% of trading fees via before/afterSwap deltas and routes them through a FeeRouter. Per-wallet and per-block buy caps are enforced during the first 100 L2 blocks to limit sniping.
